overview: Apex AI Trader is a full-stack AI-powered cryptocurrency paper trading bot. It simulates realistic trading with a $10,000 virtual portfolio, using AI to analyze market conditions across 9 regimes, generate confidence-scored trading decisions, and manage risk automatically.
features: AI-powered trading bot with 9 market regime detection
Live dashboard with bot controls (start/pause/resume/emergency stop)
Real-time portfolio tracking with equity curve charts
AI decision logs with confidence factor breakdown
Multi-timeframe market analysis for 10 top crypto assets
Historical backtesting with Sharpe ratio and drawdown metrics
Arena mode for competitive strategy testing
Risk management with configurable daily loss limits and position sizing
AI training metrics tracking strategy performance
